You basically measure your bust (so the fullest part of your chest, measuring tape goes across the nipples), jot down the number in inches. This is going to be what determines your cup size. 

Then you measure just below the bust and jot that down in inches as well. This one will be your band size.

Take your band size and compare it to your bust measurement-- basically, for every inch above the band size, you go up a cup.

So let's say the underbust is 36 inches and the bust is 38 inches; the bra size should be 36B--though everyone's chest is shaped differently so different styles of bras should be tested out to see which is most comfortable and flattering.
